## Feature Description / Requirements

When scoped expert-insights generation **completes successfully** for an on-demand request, send an **in-app notification to the initiating user only** — not tenant-wide, not other users on the account.

Notification must use:

* **Recipient:** `userId` from the request JWT 
* **Sender:** `senderId` from the same JWT 

Notification is fire-and-forget: failure must not fail the insights run.
